data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 咖啡馆角落的眼神拉扯
data.description: 闹市角落静谧的复古咖啡馆，阳光穿透木质百叶窗在地板上留下明暗条纹。诺亚身穿柔软的高领针织衫，单手托腮，修长手指轻轻搅动面前的瓷杯咖啡。她的紫罗兰眼眸带着狡黠而迷人的笑意，轻启朱唇正欲开口调侃老师。
data.action: resting chin on hand, stirring coffee with spoon, teasing charming smile
data.lighting: warm dappled sunlight filtering through wooden blinds
data.mood: playful teasing intimacy and relaxed warmth
data.promptProse: Sitting at a cozy sunlit cafe table, Ushio Noa rests her chin in one delicate hand, stirring her coffee while directing a sweet, playfully teasing gaze toward the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Noa smiling playfully across a sunlit cafe table.
